snapshot.notes: Critical trial limit check. Hallucinating 30 days is an immediate commercial blocker.
snapshot.question: How long does the OmniFlow free trial last, do I need to input a credit card, and when does it expire?
snapshot.referenceContext: OmniFlow provides a strictly 14-day free trial on all team workspaces. No credit card is required at sign-up. The trial terminates automatically at 23:59 UTC on the 14th calendar day, locking workspace edit access until a paid subscription is activated.
